media_sync.reason: Gumroad's public thumbnail endpoint accepts signed_blob_id only. The documented /v2/files/presign + /v2/files/complete flow returns file_url for sellable files, not the Rails ActiveStorage signed blob required for cover/thumbnail attachment.
media_sync.safe_fallback: The generated cover and thumbnail are included inside the synced product ZIP. Attach them in Gumroad UI unless Gumroad exposes an official OAuth endpoint that returns signed_blob_id.
media_sync.source_observation: Gumroad open-source UI uses DirectUpload(file, '/rails/active_storage/direct_uploads') and then calls thumbnail creation with blob.signed_id.

legal_note: Existing Gumroad package was updated only after --confirm-live and GUMROAD_LIVE_UPLOAD_ENABLED=true.
